correctness.rationale: Both standalone Python algorithms exhaustively generate 6240 labeled states; one via 105 perfect-matching masks and an exact-cover recursion, the other via normalized proper edge-colorings. Both explicitly construct switches for all 28 anchor pairs, deduplicate moves, verify 66360 edges, the same degree histogram and distance vectors. A full S8 orbit census and complete BFS from six orbit representatives prove connectivity, radius 5 and diameter 6 rather than extrapolate from tests.

value.rationale: The six-state isomorphism quotient leaves a meaningful reachability gap for fixed labeled round-robin schedules. The finding closes it: all 6240 schedules interconvert in at most six natural single-component vertex switches, with sharp diameter and full orbit-degree/distance stratification. It highlights the 960 configurations immobile under stricter factor switching yet admitting 14 vertex moves, a structural distinction with plausible relevance to local schedule randomization and reconfiguration.
